name: Disorder of Fatty Acid Oxidation and Ketone Body Metabolism

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Biochemical and Genetic Diagnostic Criteria for Fatty Acid Oxidation Disorders

criteria.description: Elevated plasma acylcarnitines and abnormal organic acid profile in urine
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes encoding enzymes of fatty acid oxidation or ketone metabolism
Episodes of hypoketotic hypoglycemia, cardiomyopathy, or muscle weakness triggered by fasting or illness
Reduced activity of specific mitochondrial fatty acid oxidation enzymes in fibroblasts or leukocytes

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic biochemical abnormalities plus either pathogenic genetic variants or consistent clinical presentation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis often requires integration of biochemical, genetic, and clinical data.

pathognomonic.notes: Low blood sugar with inappropriately low ketone bodies during metabolic crisis
Dilated or hypertrophic cardiomyopathy often presenting in infancy
searchTerms: heart muscle disease with irregular heartbeat

pathognomonic.symptomName: Rhabdomyolysis triggered by fasting or exercise
pathognomonic.notes: Muscle breakdown causing myoglobinuria and muscle pain
searchTerms: muscle breakdown triggered by fasting or exercise
muscle damage from exertion or fasting

common.notes: Enlarged liver and mild transaminase elevation during metabolic decompensation
searchTerms: enlarged liver with high liver enzymes

common.symptomName: Lethargy and hypotonia during metabolic crises
common.notes: Reduced muscle tone and decreased responsiveness
searchTerms: extreme tiredness and low muscle tone in crises
lethargy and floppy muscles during metabolic episodes
weakness and low tone in metabolic emergencies

common.notes: Poor growth due to recurrent metabolic decompensation
searchTerms: failure to gain weight as baby

common.notes: Low blood pressure associated with cardiac dysfunction
searchTerms: low blood pressure during metabolic crises

occasional.notes: Sensory and motor nerve involvement in some patients
Secondary to hypoglycemia or metabolic encephalopathy
Elevated blood ammonia due to impaired metabolism
searchTerms: excess ammonia in blood during crisis

rare.notes: Rare retinal changes reported in some cases
Inflammation of the pancreas during metabolic crises

laboratory: Elevated plasma acylcarnitine profile with specific chain-length abnormalities
Elevated liver transaminases and creatine kinase
imaging: MRI brain may show white matter changes during encephalopathy
genetic: Pathogenic variants in genes such as ACADM, CPT2, HADHA, HADHB, and others involved in fatty acid oxidation
Variants in genes affecting ketone body metabolism
other: Enzyme activity assays demonstrating deficient mitochondrial fatty acid oxidation

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of hyperketotic hypoglycemia rather than hypoketotic
Different genetic mutations affecting glycogen metabolism
Muscle biopsy showing ragged red fibers

redFlags: Recurrent hypoketotic hypoglycemia with metabolic acidosis
Sudden onset cardiomyopathy or arrhythmias in infancy
Rhabdomyolysis triggered by fasting or illness
references: Roe CR, et al. Fatty acid oxidation disorders. In: Scriver CR, et al., editors. The Metabolic and Molecular Bases of Inherited Disease. 8th ed. McGraw-Hill; 2001.
Spiekerkoetter U, et al. Management and outcome of fatty acid oxidation disorders. J Inherit Metab Dis. 2010;33(5):527-34.
Orphanet Report Series. Disorder of fatty acid oxidation and ketone body metabolism. Orphanet; 2023.
